scope: All ten frozen authored files, R1/R2 corrections, first-RAF stop/restart unpack transition, runner post-report smoke oracle, existing whole-chain conclusions, actual saved reports and source metadata. Read-only code inspection and Node metadata verification; no browser, third-party execution, installs or production edits.

specCompliance.reason: R1 and R2 are resolved with targeted real-boundary regressions. Required limited reference-chain behavior is supported by the reviewed code and actual 17-case reports.

quality.reason: Lifecycle corrections and runner failure propagation are coherent, bounded and covered by actual negative evidence. No remaining necessary correction found in this scoped rereview.

resolvedFindings.reason: Pending ticket and disabled button prevent duplicate creation, generation and AbortSignal invalidate pending pagehide/stop results, candidate cleanup rejects stale ownership, captured owner/generation govern the single RAF, and handler failure restores the retry UI. Real DOM handler regressions show one initial parse/context/RAF, zero post-stop listeners/RAF, and zero late allocations after pagehide.

Adapter initialization catch disposes completed UI/renderer acquisitions and parsed bundle while preserving original rejection. UI tracks pending shaders and unwinds partial program/VAO/texture. Controlled shader and Canvas text failures after real parsing and renderer creation show geometry/material dispose once, zero context listeners, zero tracked partial UI allocations and GL NO_ERROR.

Before constructing a renderer on a reused canvas context, reset PBO binding and unpack alignment/row/image/skip/flip/premultiply state. Actual first-RAF pending stop/restart red case produced GL 1282 with premultiply true; current controlled-frame-delivery regression performs three real starts and has GL NO_ERROR, one maximum RAF and no stopped listeners/RAF. The earlier normal-restart run with red in its label actually passed and is not treated as failing evidence.

Runner captures startup and stopped demo diagnostics, requires one running owner and actual frames, checks caught errors, then serializes final page/console evidence and explicit runnerOutcome. Any integration, page, console or demo failure returns exit 1. Separate negative control retains 17/17 main cases but reports demoSmoke failure and exit 1; no inflation of case counts.

evidenceVerification.executionBoundary: Reviewer inspected saved browser reports, actual production/tests and negative-control runner logic; no independent browser execution performed. Old runner report has no serialized exit code; its missed failure is corroborated by its source oracle and execution record. Original 12-report/202-hash audit rechecked; expanded integrity independently rechecked for 47 retained reports and 835 matching source entries. Current 19 source hashes and ten package hashes independently recomputed.

expandedIntegrity.boundary: Retained copies and repeated reports included; entries are not unique files or main cases. Independently rechecked saved report counts and at least one exact matching source snapshot for each entry.

acceptedWithinScope: Actual GLTFLoader, SkeletonUtils, AnimationMixer and renderer usage; no replacement parser or skinning algorithm.
Instances share geometry/material and hold independent skeleton/mixer state; final release clears owner bundle and instance roots. No heap/GC proof is claimed.
Lost-context geometry/skeleton dispose events invalidate GPU allocations while retaining CPU geometry, scene and animation ownership. They are distinct from final releaseShared.
Restore tests require nonblank mesh and bright native-text pixels plus exact fixed-frame comparisons; equal blank frames cannot pass.
UI sets its framebuffer/VAO/program/blend/depth/scissor/viewport/sampler dependencies; renderer reset precedes re-entry. Evidence covers this fixed sample, not all upstream material states.
Raw text/style/resolution/epoch cache and native Canvas calls are tested without claiming font identity, coverage or shaping implementation.
Required-extension preflight rejects unlisted required names and unknown optional names are independently tested. Asset itself has no required extensions.

Server binds 127.0.0.1, uses exact file whitelist, random report token, fixed destination and request size cap; runner uses preinstalled Playwright, records source hashes and preserves unique run reports.
nonblockingConcerns: requiredProfile remains a configured loader allowlist, not an executed extension compatibility matrix. The asset has no extensionsRequired. Draco/KTX2/meshopt paths are not configured or accepted.

Fault injection gates real parse completion and observes real DOM/GL allocation/disposal behavior; it does not validate upstream parser, skinning, animation or shader correctness from scratch. Constructor-internal partial allocation before successful return and arbitrary parser failures remain outside bounded rollback proof.

Runner smoke uses a 250 ms startup window and can fail conservatively on a slower machine; this is an environment-specific correctness smoke threshold, not a performance result. Screenshot and smoke are supplementary to 17 cases.
Five new cases, one refined restart subscenario and runner negative controls are separate evidence roles. Do not add repeated runs/subscenarios/smoke results to the main 17-case total.

No GC/heap proof of all external retention, all texture recovery, material/state matrix, real font identity/coverage, or repeated device-loss matrix is established. Original nonblank restore and exact fixed-time sample conclusions remain bounded.
Final knowledge-base/report integration is owned by root/implementer. Acceptance here is for the ten hashed files and inspected evidence, not unreviewed future documentation.
